about: The Camera lens curve κ (docs/render-contract.md, "カメラのレンズ"; ADR 0042), computed in float64 from the spec's formulas for both Python (tests/test_lens.py) and JS (tests/pano_lens.test.mjs). mapping: lens_radius(theta, curve) = tan(curve·theta) / curve (theta at curve 0), radius in units of f, and lens_angle(radius, curve) is its inverse. cases: an image of width x height pixels with hFOV hfov_deg; f = (width / 2) / lens_radius(hfov / 2, curve) in pixels; each pixel center's ray in the Camera's axes [right, up, forward], its angle from the optical axis, and whether it is drawn (theta <= 180 degrees; otherwise bg_color). limits: the largest hFOV for a curve, min(360, 179 / curve). Compare within tolerance.
